input:
You are one unit in a squad of 3 fighting 3 enemy units on a 32 by 32 map (x grows east, y grows
north). Every unit in your squad is a separate agent, like you: you control only your own unit, and the others
decide for themselves. You cannot see inside their heads; you only see their current orders and what they say
on team chat. Every half second of game time you give your unit one order:

  attack E<n>    shoot enemy E<n> when it is in range, otherwise walk toward it
  move <x> <y>   walk to a point without shooting
  hold           stand still and shoot the closest enemy in range
  retreat        walk away from the closest enemy without shooting

A unit dies at 0 health. The battle is won when every enemy is dead.
The enemy units each shoot the closest of you in range and keep shooting it until it dies.

Your squad coordinates through a Modality contract: each unit's order is a commit, and the contract refuses
any order that breaks one of its rules. It already has the rule that only a unit can write its own order.
The contract's state, which rules can test (the referee commits /world before the units order):
  /world/step.num                 half seconds since the battle began
  /world/allies_alive.num         our living units
  /world/enemies_alive.num        their living units
  /world/focus.text               the living enemy closest to our squad's centre, e.g. E1
  /world/<unit>/hp.num            every unit's health (A0.. ours, E0.. theirs)
  /world/<unit>/alive.bool        true or false
  /world/<A>/closest.text         the living enemy closest to our unit A
  /world/<A>/in_range.num         how many enemies our unit A can shoot now
  /orders/<A>.text                our unit A's order, e.g. "attack E1", "hold", "retreat", "move 10 12"
Each of our units' keys is /team/units/<A>.id; a commit is one unit's order, signed by that unit.

Your squad just fought a battle on map 3m and lost. Here is how it went, one line per half second:
our units' orders and health, the enemies' health, what was said on team chat, and orders the contract refused.

 0.0s  A0 move 14 16 (45hp)  A1 move 14 16 (45hp)  A2 move 12 16 (45hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 45hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: Advancing east together to find enemies; stay grouped, focus fire on /world/focus.
        A1 said: Advancing east together toward the centre; will focus on /world/focus.text once enemies show.
        A2 said: No contact. Advancing east to the center together; focus fire on /world/focus.
 0.5s  A0 move 14 16 (45hp)  A1 move 14 16 (45hp)  A2 move 14 16 (45hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 45hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: No contact yet; continuing east, staying grouped.
        A1 said: A1 advancing east to 14,16, staying grouped; will attack /world/focus on contact.
        A2 said: A2 advancing east to 14,16; will attack /world/focus once enemies appear.
 1.0s  A0 move 14 16 (45hp)  A1 hold (45hp)  A2 move 14 16 (45hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 45hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: E0 spotted at 19,15, out of range. Stay grouped; attack /world/focus once in range.
        A1 said: E0 spotted east at 19,15. Holding group; will attack /world/focus when in range.
        A2 said: A2 continuing east to 14,16, grouped; will attack /world/focus on contact.
 1.5s  A0 attack E0 (45hp)  A1 hold (45hp)  A2 move 13 16 (45hp)  |  E0 45hp  E1 45hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: E0 in range, attacking focus E0. Focus fire on E0.
        A1 said: A1 holding at 11.7,15.3; no enemy in range yet. Will attack focus once in range.
        A2 said: A2 closing to 13,16 to support A0; will attack /world/focus once in range.
 2.0s  A0 attack E0 (36hp)  A1 move 14 16 (45hp)  A2 attack E1 (45hp)  |  E0 36hp  E1 45hp  E2 45hp
        the contract refused A2's order "attack E0" (forbidden -post_to(/orders/A2.text, attack E0) matched (closest: $k = A2))
        A0 said: A0 attacking E0 (36hp, focus). Everyone in range focus E0.
        A1 said: A1 closing to 14,16 to join A0; will attack focus once in range.
        A2 said: A2 attacking E1, the current focus. Focus fire on E1.
 2.5s  A0 attack E1 (18hp)  A1 attack E1 (45hp)  A2 attack E1 (45hp)  |  E0 27hp  E1 45hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: Focus is E1 (closest to squad centre). Everyone attack E1.
        A1 said: In range. Attacking E1, the current focus. Everyone focus E1.
        A2 said: E1 is closest to squad centre, so focus is E1. Everyone attack E1.
 3.0s  A0 attack E1 (9hp)  A1 attack E1 (45hp)  A2 attack E1 (36hp)  |  E0 27hp  E1 18hp  E2 45hp
        A0 said: A0 attacking E1, focus. E1 at 18hp, finish it.
        A1 said: Attacking E1, the focus. E1 is at 18hp, keep firing.
        A2 said: A2 attacking E1, focus. E1 at 18hp, finish it.
 3.5s  A0 dead  A1 attack E2 (45hp)  A2 attack E2 (27hp)  |  E0 27hp  E1 dead  E2 45hp
        A1 said: E1 is dead. E2 is closest to our centre, so focus E2.
        A2 said: E1 is dead. E2 is closest to our centre, so focus E2.
 4.0s  A0 dead  A1 attack E2 (45hp)  A2 attack E2 (18hp)  |  E0 27hp  E1 dead  E2 45hp
        A1 said: Attacking E2, the focus. A2 is low, so keep firing on E2.
        A2 said: Attacking E2, the focus. Keep firing, E2 is at full health.
 4.5s  A0 dead  A1 attack E2 (45hp)  A2 attack E2 (9hp)  |  E0 27hp  E1 dead  E2 27hp
        A1 said: E2 still closest to centre, focus E2. A2 is low, keep firing.
        A2 said: Attacking E2, focus. A2 at 9hp, keep firing.
 5.0s  A0 dead  A1 attack E0 (45hp)  A2 dead  |  E0 27hp  E1 dead  E2 18hp
        A1 said: A1 alone. E0 is now closest to me, so I'm focusing E0.
 5.5s  A0 dead  A1 attack E0 (27hp)  A2 dead  |  E0 27hp  E1 dead  E2 18hp
        A1 said: A1 alone, focusing E0, closest to me and the focus.
 6.0s  A0 dead  A1 attack E0 (18hp)  A2 dead  |  E0 18hp  E1 dead  E2 18hp
        A1 said: A1 alone, E0 is the focus and closest. Attacking E0.
 6.5s  A0 dead  A1 dead  A2 dead  |  E0 9hp  E1 dead  E2 18hp

Contract rules now:
  1. A unit may commit an order of the form "attack E<n>" only if E<n> equals /world/focus.text, so that all living units in /team/units focus fire on the same enemy closest to the squad's centre instead of splitting targets or switching between E1 and E2.
     always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "attack E0") -text_eq(/world/focus.text, "E0")] false) & always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "attack E1") -text_eq(/world/focus.text, "E1")] false) & always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "attack E2") -text_eq(/world/focus.text, "E2")] false)
  2. A unit may commit the order "hold", "move" or "retreat" only when its own /world/<A>/in_range.num is 0, so that any unit with an enemy in range must commit "attack" on /world/focus.text every half second instead of idling or splitting its fire.
     always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "hold") -num_eq(/world/$k/in_range.num, "0")] false) & always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "move") -num_eq(/world/$k/in_range.num, "0")] false) & always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "retreat") -num_eq(/world/$k/in_range.num, "0")] false)
Write ONE new rule for the contract that would have helped you win this battle. It will be turned into a
Modality formula and checked against every order in later battles, so it must be about the orders units may
commit and the facts above, naming the paths. Make it one sentence, and do not repeat a rule already there.
Reply with JSON only: {"rule": "<the rule>"}
response: {"rule": "A unit may commit an order of the form \"attack E<n>\" only when /world/allies_alive.num is at least /world/enemies_alive.num, so the squad engages only when it is not outnumbered and does not trickle into a losing fight."}
